fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-02-26, a smartphone in a blue cover was allegedly snatched from the hand of the complainant at Kalai Park Main Street by a person who left quickly. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-02-26 at approximately 18:00. Pandian Thangaraj (mobile 9000000427) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant noted the registration number TN-68-XX-1018 of a maroon motorcycle. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Phone allegedly lifted during a brief distraction in a crowded area.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, suspect, evening, motorcycle, mobile number, main street, call detail
